{{Quote|Though the Republic is thriving and the galaxy is...relatively...at peace, there remains a need for the likes of myself and my associates. If you're tired of smash-and-grab pirates in your system; if a former associate has fled with your property; indeed, if any being has done you wrong, don't hesitate: contact the Bounty Hunter's Guild.|Cradossk|<ref name="The Bounty Hunters: Aurra Sing">''[[The Bounty Hunters: Aurra Sing]]''</ref>}}
'''Cradossk''' was a legendary [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who led the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]]. He was also the father of the notorious bounty hunter [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|That trigger-happy idiot you just shot is my son, Bossk."<br />"He's only stunned."<br />"You could have shot me, too. Why didn't you?"<br />"Because you're not a trigger-happy idiot, Cradossk. You're just a professional with a bad gene pool."<br />"We could join forces."<br />"I work alone. You should, too."<br />"Listen, Jango. I respect you, and you know it. We don't have to be adversaries.|Cradossk and Jango Fett|<ref name="SWA4">''[[Star Wars Adventures 4: Jango Fett vs. the Razor Eaters]]''</ref>}}
Born on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Trandosha/Legends|Trandosha]], Cradossk left his family and became a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] like many other young [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Cradossk was extremely successful as a bounty hunter and became a living legend for many bounty hunters who envied his success.

[[File:SW-Adventures-Cradossk.jpg|thumb|left|125px|Cradossk in 23 BBY]]
Before the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]] hired Cradossk and his 29-year-old son, [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]], to hunt [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Rodd]], [[Groodo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] and [[Hurlo Holowan]]. This led the father and son to search for them from [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]] to [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]]. But [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] beat them to the prize, handing the criminals over to [[Dooku/Legends|Darth Tyranus]], who, unlike Tambor, wanted them alive.<ref name="HostagePrincess">''[[Star Wars Adventures 3: The Hostage Princess]]''</ref><ref name="SWA4" /><ref name="ShapeShifter">''[[Star Wars Adventures 5: The Shape-Shifter Strikes]]''</ref><ref name="Warlords">''[[Star Wars Adventures 6: The Warlords of Balmorra]]''</ref>

By the time of the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], Cradossk had become the [[Guild Master/Legends|guildmaster]] of the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]]. When a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] named [[Reeft]] accidentally killed a guild hunter named [[Tosinqas]] as they both followed the same quarry, Cradossk issued a stern rebuke to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] following the incident, saying that better communication was needed, and that the death of a licensed hunter was unacceptable.<ref name="Hnn">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|53|jediwatch/13425_2.html|Three-Way Hunt Ends with Two Dead}}</ref> Jango Fett stoically resisted Cradossk's tenacious attempts to get him to join the Bounty Hunters Guild. Fett explained his refusal to join the Guild to his [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] son [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba]], telling him that he didn't like social groups or "self-congratulating braggarts."<ref name="SWA4" /> And he spurned any kind of supervision.<ref name="Maze">''[[Boba Fett: Maze of Deception]]''</ref>

Around the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Cradossk appeared alongside Bossk in the [[Holovid/Legends|holovid]] collection ''[[The Bounty Hunters' Guild's Greatest Hits: Volume VII]]'', which recorded a number of disputes between the pair.<ref name="Curse of the Black Hole Pirates">''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 2: Curse of the Black Hole Pirates]]''</ref>

Cradossk built up a fearsome reputation during his time as a hunter, and it was said that even Boba Fett held some respect for him: Fett would include Cradossk's short memoir, ''[[Making a Killing]]'', in his copy of ''[[The Bounty Hunter Code]]''. However, with age, even Cradossk started to decline in strength. His son, Bossk, grew resentful of the elderly hunter as he saw more and more weakness within him. Cradossk noticed Bossk's rebellious ways, and attempted to kill him through his partner [[Zuckuss/Legends|Zuckuss]] during one of their missions. Zuckuss returned to Cradossk following their hunt and lied about Bossk being dead. To Cradossk's surprise, Bossk then entered the room. Cradossk was ultimately killed and devoured in his son's rage, helping to begin the [[Bounty Hunter Wars]].
